The plate holds scrambled eggs and about 3 strips of bacon.

The eggs look like roughly 2–3 eggs' worth, about 150 g. Scrambled eggs cooked with butter run about 1.5 kcal/g, so about 225 kcal.

The bacon looks like 3 strips, since one strip seems to be broken or overlapping. Cooked bacon is about 40 kcal and 8 g per strip, so about 120 kcal and 25 g.

That gives about 345 kcal and 175 g in total.
